Purpose and Scope

The @ohos/webview component is OpenHarmony's comprehensive web rendering solution that enables applications to embed web content and execute web-based functionality. This component provides a complete web engine infrastructure with native integration capabilities across JavaScript/ArkTS, Native C/C++, and CJ programming environments.

Scope of this document: This overview introduces the architecture, primary components, and initialization flow of the webview system. For detailed information on specific subsystems:

  • API interfaces and programming models: see API Interfaces
  • Core engine implementation: see Core Engine
  • Platform integration adapters: see Platform Integration
  • Advanced features (JavaScript proxies, message ports, scheme handlers): see Advanced Features

Component Architecture

The webview system is organized into five architectural layers that separate concerns from application interfaces down to the web rendering engine and platform services.

Sources: bundle.json1-427 ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp1-1157 interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/napi_webview_controller.cpp1-3925

Primary Components

The webview system centers around three core components that manage initialization, instance lifecycle, and event handling.

Sources: ohos_nweb/include/nweb_helper.h67-178 interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.h165-423 ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h345-897

NWebHelper

NWebHelper (defined at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp598-602) is a singleton class that orchestrates the entire webview system. Key responsibilities:

  • Engine Loading: LoadWebEngine(fromArk, runFlag) at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp765-777 initializes the ArkWeb bridge and obtains the NWebEngine instance
  • Instance Management: CreateNWeb(create_info) and GetNWeb(nweb_id) at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp794-822 manage webview instances
  • Configuration: InitWebEngine() at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp697-763 sets up command-line arguments, user data directories, and locale settings
  • Global Operations: Methods like GetCookieManager(), SetHttpDns(), PrepareForPageLoad() provide singleton services

Sources: ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp587-1157 ohos_nweb/include/nweb_helper.h67-178

WebviewController

WebviewController (defined at interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.cpp113-146) serves as the application-facing handle to a webview instance. Key characteristics:

  • Instance Tracking: Each controller stores nwebId_ and registers itself in g_webview_controller_map at interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.cpp116-118
  • Attachment State: Manages attachState_ (NOT_ATTACHED/ATTACHED) with condition variables for synchronization at interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.cpp126-145
  • Event Registry: attachEventRegisterInfo_ stores NAPI callbacks for lifecycle events at interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.h417-418
  • Native Tagging: Supports webTag_ for binding to native instances via OH_NativeArkWeb_BindWebTagToWebInstance() at interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.cpp202

Sources: interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.cpp113-293 interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.h165-423

NWeb Interface

The NWeb abstract class (defined at ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h345-897) defines all webview operations. Core method categories:

  • Lifecycle: OnPause(), OnContinue(), OnDestroy() at ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h353-355
  • Navigation: Load(), NavigateBack(), NavigateForward(), Reload() at ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h381-535
  • JavaScript Execution: ExecuteJavaScript(), RegisterArkJSfunction() at ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h537-618
  • Configuration: GetPreference() returns NWebPreference for settings at ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h684-685
  • State Query: Title(), GetWebId(), PageLoadProgress() at ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h619-692

The interface is implemented by ArkWebNWebWrapper at ohos_interface/ohos_glue/ohos_nweb/bridge/webview/ark_web_nweb_wrapper.h33-507 which delegates to the actual ArkWeb engine.

Sources: ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h345-897 ohos_interface/ohos_glue/ohos_nweb/bridge/webview/ark_web_nweb_wrapper.h16-507

API Entry Points

Applications interact with the webview system through language-specific APIs that converge on the core engine layer.

Sources: interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/napi_webview_controller.cpp650-3925 interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/webview_controller.cpp1-2556 interfaces/native/libohweb.cpp1-1357

NAPI Layer

The NAPI layer provides JavaScript/ArkTS bindings defined in NapiWebviewController at interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/napi_webview_controller.cpp650-3925 Key patterns:

  • Property Descriptors: Init() at interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/napi_webview_controller.cpp650-850 declares 100+ NAPI functions
  • Parameter Parsing: Uses NapiParseUtils to extract and validate JavaScript arguments
  • Error Handling: BusinessError::ThrowErrorByErrcode() translates C++ errors to JavaScript exceptions
  • Async Operations: Supports both callback and promise patterns for asynchronous methods

Sources: interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/napi_webview_controller.cpp650-3925 interfaces/kits/napi/webviewcontroller/napi_webview_controller.h79-473

Native C API

The Native API exposes ~20 functions prefixed with OH_NativeArkWeb_* at interfaces/native/libohweb.cpp1-1357 Core functions:

  • OH_NativeArkWeb_RunJavaScript() at interfaces/native/libohweb.cpp249-285
  • OH_NativeArkWeb_RegisterJavaScriptProxy() at interfaces/native/libohweb.cpp287-354
  • OH_ArkWeb_GetNativeAPI() factory pattern at interfaces/native/libohweb.cpp1294-1350

These APIs bypass the NAPI layer and directly invoke NWebHelper::GetNWeb() to operate on webview instances.

Sources: interfaces/native/libohweb.cpp1-1357 interfaces/native/libohweb.h1-143

Initialization and Lifecycle

The webview system follows a multi-stage initialization sequence before becoming operational.

Sources: ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp604-777 test/unittest/nweb_helper_test/nweb_helper_test.cpp190-268

Stage 1: Engine Loading

The engine loading phase (LoadWebEngine() at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp765-777) performs:

  1. Bundle Path Setup: Retrieves application bundle path via ApplicationContext::GetBundleCodeDir() at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp655-665
  2. Bridge Initialization: ArkWebNWebWebviewBridgeHelper::Init(fromArk, bundlePath_) at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp669-672 loads the engine library
  3. Engine Instance: NWebEngine::GetInstance() returns the singleton at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp680-684
  4. Custom Schemes: RegisterCustomSchemes() at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp625-646 registers URL schemes before engine startup

Sources: ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp648-695 ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp765-777

Stage 2: Engine Initialization

The InitWebEngine() method at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp697-763 configures the web engine with:

  • User Data Directory: --user-data-dir= + application base directory at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp717
  • Bundle Installation: --bundle-installation-dir= + bundle path at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp718
  • Locale Settings: --lang= derived from LocaleConfig::GetSystemLanguage() and region at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp729-737
  • Feature Flags: Back-forward cache, custom schemes, API version at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp739-756
  • Network Settings: Socket idle timeout via --socket-idle-timeout= at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp756

The method calls nwebEngine_->InitializeWebEngine(initArgs) at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp758 to apply the configuration.

Sources: ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp697-763

Stage 3: Instance Creation

Applications create webview instances via NWebHelper::CreateNWeb(create_info) at ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp794-802 which delegates to nwebEngine_->CreateNWeb(create_info). The NWebCreateInfo structure at ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h114-133 specifies:

  • Surface: GetProducerSurface() for rendering output
  • Dimensions: GetWidth() and GetHeight() for initial size
  • Init Args: GetEngineInitArgs() for per-instance configuration
  • Incognito Mode: GetIsIncognitoMode() for private browsing

Each instance receives a unique ID accessible via nweb->GetWebId().

Sources: ohos_nweb/src/nweb_helper.cpp794-802 ohos_interface/include/ohos_nweb/nweb.h114-133

Build System and Distribution

The webview component is built and distributed through OpenHarmony's build system with specialized code generation for the bridge layer.

Sources: bundle.json1-427 ohos_nweb/BUILD.gn1-224 ohos_adapter/BUILD.gn1-427 ohos_glue/BUILD.gn1-603

Component Configuration

The bundle.json file at bundle.json1-427 defines the webview component with:

  • Component Name: "name": "webview" under subsystem "web" at bundle.json2-14
  • System Capabilities: "SystemCapability.Web.Webview.Core" at bundle.json15-17
  • Dependencies: 60+ OpenHarmony components including ability_runtime, graphic_2d, napi, window_manager at bundle.json28-92
  • Build Targets: 10+ sub_component entries at bundle.json95-109 pointing to BUILD.gn files
  • Resource Estimates: ROM ~85MB, RAM ~150MB at bundle.json25-26

Sources: bundle.json1-427

Bridge Code Generation

The bridge layer uses a code generation pipeline defined in ohos_glue/BUILD.gn1-603:

  1. IDL Processing: prepare.sh translate at ohos_glue/BUILD.gn86-149 processes interface definitions from ohos_interface/
  2. cpptoc Generation: Creates C wrappers for C++ classes at ohos_glue/BUILD.gn151-350
  3. ctocpp Generation: Creates C++ wrappers for C interfaces at ohos_glue/BUILD.gn352-499
  4. Bridge Generation: Generates ArkWebXxxWrapper and ArkWebXxxImpl pairs at ohos_glue/BUILD.gn501-603

This allows bidirectional communication between OpenHarmony's NWeb types and ArkWeb engine types.

Sources: ohos_glue/BUILD.gn1-603

Prebuilt Engine Distribution

The actual web rendering engine is distributed as a prebuilt HAP file:

  • Architecture Variants: arm64 and arm builds at ohos_nweb/BUILD.gn20-29
  • HAP Installation: Installed to /system/app/ArkWebCore/ by nweb_hap target at ohos_nweb/BUILD.gn157-163
  • Dynamic Loading: libnweb.so (renamed to arkweb_core_loader) loads the engine at runtime via ArkWebBridge at ohos_nweb/BUILD.gn98-155
  • Configuration Files: Includes web_config.xml, parameter files, and SVG resources at ohos_nweb/BUILD.gn165-198

Sources: ohos_nweb/BUILD.gn1-224
